chunks: As for whatever is in it from Abū Jarīr ibn Idrīs, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh — may Allah be pleased with him — from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Abū Jarīr ibn Idrīs, the companion of Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي جَرِيرِ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ: A transmitter whose chain is being clarified here
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal statement of narration
key_terms.صَاحِبِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ: Companion of Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū Jarīr ibn Idrīs in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū Jarīr ibn Idrīs. It serves as a chain-reference statement identifying both the intermediaries and Abū Jarīr’s association with Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام.
